comment: Which output carries which signal was settled from the Mutable resonator code: at minimum SPACE the left jack carries the resonator and the right jack the raw exciter. Strength is inverted relative to the hardware: the Mutable manual describes positive CV boosting the excitation, while the plugin computes 1 minus the voltage over 5, so 0V gives full strength and 5V silences it. The plugin behaviour is what the line describes.
